site.author: camilla perotto
site.title: the movements of accessibility: interactions between regulation, land use and mobility in são paulo between 2013 and 2022

figures.delta: fig. 1 — % change in accessibility per hexagon, 2013 → 2022

map.source: source: perotto (2025), insper — rais, ibge census, gtfs and openstreetmap

access_2013.label: job accessibility, 2013
access_2013.description: formal jobs reachable within 60 min by public transport and active modes, weighted by the hexagon's population. quantiles (k=8) of hexagons with access > 0.

access_2022.label: job accessibility, 2022
access_2022.description: formal jobs reachable within 60 min by public transport and active modes, weighted by the hexagon's population. quantiles (k=8) of hexagons with access > 0.

delta_pct.label: change in accessibility, 2013 → 2022
delta_pct.description: percentage change in the accessibility index between 2013 and 2022. continuous scale from −100% to +100%.

delta_pct_jobs_solo.label: scenario i — jobs: change vs. 2013
delta_pct_jobs_solo.description: % change in accessibility relative to 2013 when only the distribution of jobs changes, keeping 2013 population and transport network. continuous scale from −70% to +70%.

delta_pct_housing_solo.label: scenario ii — population: change vs. 2013
delta_pct_housing_solo.description: % change in accessibility relative to 2013 when only the distribution of population changes, keeping 2013 jobs and transport network. continuous scale from −70% to +70%.

delta_pct_network_solo.label: scenario iii — transport: change vs. 2013
delta_pct_network_solo.description: % change in accessibility relative to 2013 when only the transport network changes, keeping 2013 jobs and population. continuous scale from −70% to +70%.

jobs_2013.label: formal jobs per hexagon, 2013
jobs_2013.description: formal jobs from rais 2013 geocoded to the hexagon — the destinations of the 2013 accessibility index. 2013 quantiles (k=7), applied to both years.

jobs_2021.label: formal jobs per hexagon, 2021
jobs_2021.description: formal jobs from rais 2021 geocoded to the hexagon — the destinations of the 2022 accessibility index. 2013 quantiles (k=7), applied to both years.

pop_2010.label: population per hexagon, 2010
pop_2010.description: 2010 census population interpolated from the ibge statistical grid to the hexagon — used as the 2013 population in the index. 2010 quantiles (k=7), applied to both years.

pop_2022.label: population per hexagon, 2022
pop_2022.description: 2022 census population interpolated from the ibge statistical grid to the hexagon. 2010 quantiles (k=7), applied to both years.

eetu.label: transport axes
eetu.description: urban transformation axes (eetu): strips along metro, rail and bus corridors where the 2014 master plan allows higher density. includes the axes on the master plan map and those activated by decree in 2015–2016.

economic.label: economic zones
economic.description: areas aimed at economic activity: centrality zones (zc), economic development zones (zde) and predominantly industrial zones (zpi), economic development incentive perimeters (pide), the jaguaré technology park and the creative economy hub.
